# Breach before the deadline

`customer_support.pb.sla_management.breach_before_the_deadline` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> When a clock is going to be missed, say so before it is missed — with a new commitment and a reason — rather than after.

The apology is cheap before the deadline and expensive after it. Customers remember whether they were told, far more sharply than whether it was met; a disclosed miss is a relationship event, an undisclosed one is a trust event.
